Integer overflow vulnerability occurs when an arithmetic operation results in a numeric value outside the range of the integer type, causing truncated values due to limitations in the EVM stack.

The revenue lost vulnerability occurs when a contract relies on external calls to transfer Ether without having its own functions to send Ether. This can result in all Ether in the contract being permanently lost.
The delegatecall vulnerability arises when an attacker can manipulate the argument of delegatecall, potentially gaining control over the contract and executing arbitrary code.
